verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear left column (eyebrow, big headline, body, legal) with the product circle on the right. But the Shop Sale button floats on its own in the middle gutter, cut off from the copy it belongs to, and the circle is pressed against the right edge. B breaks apart: '20% off' sits well below the eyebrow with a large gap, the body copy floats up in the middle column above it so the reading order is jumbled, the CTA sits alone at the bottom, and the legal line is tiny and parked under the circle, too small to read.
